parsed.name: 二维数据视图组件
parsed.description: 一个用于实验软件中的非物理二维数据显示组件，用于绘制和操作图像数据。它支持图像显示、ROI 区域、十字光标、线剖面、直方图、图例、坐标轴标签与缩放，常用于相机图像或扫描成像结果的实时可视化与分析。
parsed.description_en: A non-physical 2D data visualization component used in laboratory software to plot and manipulate image data. It supports image display, ROIs, crosshair, lineouts, histogram, legend, axis labels, and axis scaling, and is commonly used for real-time visualization and analysis of camera images or scanned imaging data.
